tasks.title: Fix PowerPoint Repair Error on createBlank() PPTX Export
tasks.description: Investigate and resolve the OpenXML corruption causing PowerPoint to prompt for repair when opening PPTX decks exported from PPTXTemplater.createBlank(). Fix missing/malformed root relationships (_rels/.rels), slide layouts, theme structures, content type overrides ([Content_Types].xml), and ensure synchronous/asynchronous readiness (e.g. preloading cached XML tree).

tasks.title: Validate OpenXML Integrity Across All Export Adapters
tasks.description: Ensure presentations created via createBlank() export cleanly across saveToFile(), toBuffer(), toStream(), toArrayBuffer(), toExpress(), and toFastify() without throwing corrupt ZIP or schema warnings during validatePresentation().

tasks.title: Update Documentation & Showcase for createBlank
tasks.description: Verify showcase/input_export.js creates and exports a blank presentation cleanly with zero repair prompts.
